description: This PHP source file defines the TimeConfigPeriodAPI class, a backend API endpoint for managing the time sheet period configuration in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods to get and update the period start day, with associated validation rules, service retrieval, and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: TimeConfigPeriodAPI
classes.description: API endpoint for managing the time sheet period configuration, including retrieving and updating the start day for timesheet periods, as well as associated validation and service interactions.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve the current timesheet period configuration, including whether it is defined and the start day.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update the start day of the timesheet period and enables relevant menu items after updating.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request, excluding ID parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating the timesheet period, including ensuring the period is not already defined and validating the start day parameter.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the timesheet period configuration (not implemented).

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation (not implemented).

methods.name: getTimesheetPeriodService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the TimesheetPeriodService instance used for managing timesheet periods.
